definitions.explanation: Lacking any plan or forethought; doing things in a disorganized way.

examples.japanese: {無計画|むけいかく}な{旅行|りょこう}。
{無計画|むけいかく}に{買|か}い{物|もの}をすると{無駄遣|むだづか}いが{増|ふ}える。
examples.english: If you shop without a plan, wasteful spending increases.

examples.japanese: {無計画|むけいかく}な{開発|かいはつ}が{環境|かんきょう}{破壊|はかい}につながった。
examples.english: Unplanned development led to environmental destruction.

notes:
Formed from {無|む} (without) + {計画|けいかく} (plan). Used both as a na-adjective ({無計画|むけいかく}な) and as a noun. Often carries a negative connotation, implying carelessness or irresponsibility.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無計画|むけいかく}な{行動|こうどう}: unplanned actions
- {無計画|むけいかく}な{支出|ししゅつ}: unplanned spending
- {無計画|むけいかく}に{進|すす}める: to proceed without a plan
- {無計画|むけいかく}な{都市|とし}{開発|かいはつ}: unplanned urban development

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {行|い}き{当|あ}たりばったり: haphazard; random — more colloquial; emphasizes leaving things to chance
- {計画性|けいかくせい}がない: lacking planning ability — focuses on a personal trait rather than a specific action
- {無秩序|むちつじょ}: disorderly; chaotic — stronger, implying active disorder rather than just lack of planning
